name: Utility and behaviour
description: Components with little or no appearance whose behaviour is nonetheless part of the contract. A library that omits these forces every product to reinvent them inconsistently.

components.name: Visually hidden
components.anatomy: Content available to assistive technology and hidden from sight.
components.semantics: Must not use display:none. Focusable variants become visible when focused, as the skip link does.
components.crystal: The clipping recipe and the focusable variant

components.name: Skip link
components.anatomy: A visually hidden link that appears on focus and jumps to the main region.
components.geometry: Pill; appears at the top-left inset
components.semantics: First focusable element in the document; its target must be focusable

components.name: Focus trap
components.anatomy: A region that contains keyboard focus while active.
components.semantics: Restores focus to the trigger on release; never traps without a visible, keyboard-reachable exit
components.product: The implementation. Use a maintained primitive rather than rebuilding it.

components.name: Transition
components.anatomy: Entry and exit choreography bound to Crystal's timings and easings.
components.geometry: Travel from the motion scale: 5-30px ordinary, up to 50px expressive
components.semantics: Reduced motion removes spatial change and keeps state feedback; transitions are interruptible and never delay a semantic change
components.crystal: Timings, easings, travel limits, the 5s ceiling, reduced-motion behaviour

components.name: Direction provider
components.anatomy: The scope declaring text direction for its subtree.
components.geometry: Mirrors directional geometry: bubble corners, selection rails, range tracks, drawer edges
components.semantics: Sets a real dir attribute; logical properties do the rest
components.crystal: Which properties are directional and must mirror

components.name: Theme provider
components.anatomy: The scope supplying resolved Crystal tokens to its subtree.
components.geometry: Supplies the content radius and spacing scale
components.semantics: Sets color-scheme so native controls and scrollbars match; respects the system preference when set to system
components.crystal: Token resolution, mode switching, preference persistence, reduced-effect handling
components.product: Which palette, and where preferences are stored

components.name: Reduced effects
components.anatomy: The scope that replaces translucency and diffusion with solid equivalents.
components.material: Solid surfaces replacing every translucent fill; hierarchy preserved by tone and contour
components.geometry: Unchanged. Shapes, silhouettes and spacing never change with effects.
components.semantics: Honours prefers-reduced-transparency and forced-colors, and an explicit product preference
components.crystal: Every material's fallback and the guarantee that hierarchy survives
components.product: Exposing the preference and respecting the system setting
components.note: A compliant fallback never excuses an inaccessible default. Both presentations must pass.

components.name: Resizable region
components.anatomy: A region whose size the person controls, with a visible grab handle.
components.material: Resin handle on the region's own surface
components.geometry: Handle meets 44px even when the visible grip is narrower
components.semantics: role=separator with aria-valuenow and arrow-key resizing. Pointer dragging is never the only route.
components.crystal: Handle treatment, bound states and the settle after a size change
components.note: Layout settles after a measured size change; focus and hover states never animate.
